agenda_items.title: Application to Rezone 902 Walfred Road from Rural Residential 5 (RR5) to Residential Small Lot 1 (RS1) to accommodate an 13-lot bare land strata subdivision.
agenda_items.description: The committee recommended proceeding with consideration of the rezoning subject to amenity contributions, stormwater review, frontage improvements, construction management, vegetation retention, and protection of 31% of the site as open space. Residents raised extensive concerns about drainage, slope stability, tree removal, traffic, blasting, and consultation; the applicant offered further drainage discussions with neighbours.
agenda_items.plain_english_summary: Considered rezoning for 13 residential lots at 902 Walfred Road, with stormwater and greenspace protections.
agenda_items.debate_summary: The applicant said the subdivision would retain about 30% greenspace and that the design would control site drainage. Nearby residents argued the steep, treed slope and existing drainage problems made the proposal risky, called for updated studies and lower density, and raised traffic and construction concerns. The committee nevertheless recommended proceeding with conditions, including a stormwater technical memo before public hearing.

agenda_items.title: Application to Rezone 2822, 2824, and 2828 Jacklin Road from the One- and Two-Family Residential (R2) Zone to the City Centre Pedestrian (CCP) Zone to Allow for the Development of a 12-Storey Mixed Use Building
agenda_items.description: The committee recommended proceeding with consideration of the rezoning, subject to amenity contributions, a stormwater memo, lot consolidation, parking allocation, electric-vehicle charging, frontage improvements, and construction parking management. The public discussion included support for housing near services and transit as well as concerns about building height, parking, school capacity, safety, sidewalks, and construction impacts.
agenda_items.plain_english_summary: Considered a 12-storey mixed-use building with about 88 homes and ground-floor commercial space on Jacklin Road.
agenda_items.related_address: ["2822 Jacklin Road","2824 Jacklin Road","2828 Jacklin Road"]
agenda_items.debate_summary: Supporters said higher density near transit, services, and parks would provide needed housing and support walkable neighbourhoods. Opponents raised concerns about height, local parking, school capacity, pedestrian safety, construction effects, and whether building and commercial parking would be sufficient. The applicant described a 12-storey concept and said details would be addressed through later development-permit review.

agenda_items.title: 939 Klahanie Drive - Rezoning Application
agenda_items.description: Recommendation to Council to rezone the property from Rural Residential 2 to Rural Residential 5, approve variances allowing subdivision without municipal sewer, and impose frontage, stormwater, construction management, tree protection, low-carbon concrete and one-home-per-lot conditions.
agenda_items.plain_english_summary: The committee recommended two one-acre lots, each limited to one single-family home without an additional suite.
agenda_items.debate_summary: The applicants sought permission for one additional accessible family home, explaining that municipal sewer is not planned for the area for more than ten years and that neighbours supported the proposal. Discussion addressed sewer and septic policy, riparian and agricultural land concerns, the requested carriage-house alternative, and the long-term development potential.
